normal.name: Sam Thul
normal.text: Where are my retro gaming nerds? 😂 Amiga, DOS, Sierra, Ultima, Gold Box RPGs... all that glorious '80s/'90s shit. If you're into old games and computers, say hi and give me a follow. I'll check out your stuff too! What game got you hooked? #RetroGaming #Amiga

normal.name: The Walking Tim
normal.text: My “Aren’t You Forgetting Someone?” for this image, unless *I’m* overlooking them. Top 10 MCD game and historically significant (first score in a video game performed by a full orchestra AFAIK). They deserve seats at the table.

normal.name: alexvaleriehill.bsky.social
normal.text: There had been celebrities in video games before. This was the first "Holy shit, they got a capital-a Actor!" moment I can remember. Patrick Stewart did not need to slum it up in a 2005 Bethesda video game. But my god did he end up giving this hobby some legitimacy. More than games deserved.

normal.name: Jed Whitaker
normal.text: Knuckle Creek is out on Steam. It's a slapstick comedy brawler where you get to make an old man that looks like he is made of clay, then fight in Smash Bros like combat (I think???). Anyways that is besides the point, it has one of the best launch trailers ever, trust me:

normal.name: Richard Wakeling
normal.text: Ah man, this one stings. Patrick Stewart is the definition of a legend. He could do anything, and often would, whether it was some big Hollywood blockbuster, a small role in a comedy, perfecting Shakespeare on stage, or lending his voice to some random old PC game. He was the best.

normal.name: Colin Spacetwinks
normal.text: glad patrick stewart got to do just about everything he felt like and have a good time doing it, from star trek to shakespeare to american dad to random old PC games like Lands of Lore. nice full life
